answer: Before an agent can collect identity-only subsidies, its key burns an activation toll F. A vault caps that key's lifetime subsidy at R, with R < F. A farm of n keys spends nF to harvest at most nR, so splitting identities cannot yield a profit. Buyers may still pay separately for real yarrow or copper research; joining is not itself an earning strategy. The toll deters subsidy farming but burdens honest newcomers and leaves wealthy governance attacks possible.
